title: Interregion Cutover Ambassador: readiness validation and KV prefill checks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an "Ambassador" subsystem that performs lightweight readiness validation for candidate failover target regions, verifies KV cache prefill health, and produces a weighted readiness score to drive staged cutovers. The goal is to reduce cold-start rate and SLO violations during region failovers by validating model variant compatibility, cache warmth, and per-tier routing constraints before traffic shift begins.
acceptance_criteria: Ambassador service returns a readiness score (0-100) for each region within 500ms
Readiness scoring factors include model-variant-compatibility, KV cache hit-rate (simulated), GPU memory watermark, and RTT to control plane
If score >= 80, region is eligible for staged cutover; if between 50-79, region is eligible only for low-priority tiers (tier-2/tier-3)
Automated prefill task can seed top-100 prefixes for the target model variant within configured budget (CPU/GPU) and report estimated warm-rate
Runbook automation will block cutover when Ambassador detects model-variant ABI mismatch or prefilling error with >=3 consecutive failures
End-to-end test in the staging lab that simulates a region outage and verifies successful staged cutover with <2x latency P95 increase and no more than 10% request error spike
technical_notes: Design uses a local, ephemeral Ambassador deployed as a lightweight stateless pod per region. It calls the same model-serving API but in a read-only mode for KV cache and model metadata probes. Probes are rate-limited and cost-capped. Readiness score is a weighted sum: compatibility(30%), cache_prefill_estimate(30%), resource_headroom(25%), control_plane_rtt(15%). We'll store recent readiness snapshots in Redis with TTL for decision hysteresis.
steps: Design Ambassador API and score schema
Implement probe runners for model metadata, small inference dry-run, and KV-prefill estimator
Add circuit-breaker logic and hysteresis to prevent flapping
Integrate Ambassador output into the Cutover Controller decision path
Create staging lab harness and synthetic traffic scenarios
Run compliance review and perf benchmark
Ship feature flag gated rollout to canary accounts
progress_updates: 2026-02-15: Spec drafted and reviewed with runtime leads. Decided on 4 scoring axes and Redis snapshot TTL=90s.
2026-02-22: Prototype probe runner implemented (metadata + dry-run). Initial probe latency ~380ms in us-west-2 staging.
2026-02-28: KV-prefill estimator integrated; estimator uses sample of top-1k prefixes and a simulation of cache hit projection.

2026-03-04: Integration spike with Cutover Controller completed; controller accepts Ambassador readiness snapshot but uses feature flag hold; discovered race when controller retries concurrently—added per-target lock.
2026-03-08: Ran CI job that simulates a failover to eu-central; measured warm-rate improvement from 4% to 67% on first 10s of cutover when prefill budget enabled.
2026-03-10: API response SLA regression observed under high probe concurrency in staging (P99 increased). Tuned concurrency and added backoff; PR opened for rate-limiter fixes.
review_feedback: PM review: prefer explicit per-customer opt-in for aggressive prefill due to cost exposure (see note in artifacts)
SRE: suggested adding a decay window to readiness snapshots to avoid oscillation during noisy network periods
Design: UI wants an Ambassador health timeline chart in Console for ops visibility
Security: thumbs up on read-only probes but requested a short threat model doc for dry-run queries
prs: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2201 - redis snapshot schema and IAM policies
test_plan: Create staged lab with three regions (us-west, eu-central, ap-southeast). Tests: 1) Cold failover without prefill, 2) Failover with Ambassador prefill enabled, 3) Variant-mismatch injection to ensure blocking path works. Measure latency P50/P95/P99 and error spike. Automate as a Jenkins pipeline step and add to chaos-canary suite.
rollout_plan: Gate behind feature flag 'ambassador-cutover-v1'. Start with internal canary (redwood-admin org) for 48h, then 5 customers in controlled canary for 7 days, then gradual ramp to 30% of failover events, monitoring SLOs and cost metrics. Enable opt-in in Console per account for aggressive prefill.
risks_mitigation: Risk: Prefill increases cloud egress and GPU cycles. Mitigation: per-account budget caps and telemetry alerts. Risk: False positives in compatibility probe cause unnecessary blocks. Mitigation: conservative thresholds and manual override via runbook.
next_steps: Address PR feedback on rate limiter (infra PR #2201), target merge by 2026-03-12
Add Console visualization ticket (create PM follow-up) and link to this issue
Run extended chaos test with induced network flaps and collect readiness snapshot trends
Schedule oncall walkthrough with SRE and PM the week of 2026-03-15
